review_notes.evidence: Native FC prints A-E4F3. A1 locates the 3388C1 card portion at A-E4B3. The printed location is preserved literally; the mismatch is explicitly retained rather than using A1 to replace source lettering.
Native - DECODE LS REG 11 input prints LS401AC4, also used by the preceding register10 input. The duplicate literal reference is preserved.

Native block grid IDs, aligned borders and fields fit standard bank columns50,73,96,119,142,165,188 and rows2+7n; local scan skew and glyph bearings do not change the printed lattice. All box bottoms are open. Uppercase and P.N./value gaps follow explicit user policy. No bank shift applied.

Each native printed pin and wedge inspected separately. Blank printed_pin denotes an unlabeled physical port, not inferred lettering. Printed passive connections, where present, use null driver and distinct literal terminal endpoints; prefixes are numeric printed qualifiers.

review_notes.location: Independent LS501 native source and preview review
review_notes.evidence: All 39 native blocks and printed fields, physical borders, wedges, literal pin labels and feedthrough stars examined in upper, lower and detail crops. All 16 incoming decode rails and repeated AC4 origin on REG11 preserved; all 16 normal and inverted outputs traced through native corridors, including DH3K to EH5K via row77 and the separate DH starred forward corridor at row78. GT09 uses LS081/121/155 and LS091/131,101/141,111/151; other gate reference groups use LS083/123/157 and LS093/133,103/143,113/153. Native first reference stem has three diamonds and a lower elbow; other short hooks retained. Write feedback FB.B09 to FC.D13, BK.B05 to FB.D09, FC.D13 starred to FD.B03 and all three write paths examined. FC literal F3 location differs from A1 B3; mismatch preserved. Four connector columns inspected separately, including AC4 A-E4H1A09 and FC4 A-D4M2D09 to 02A-E4C2D09. Full title, part2585430, FE, log153A, date08-14-69 and single EC713380 inspected. Upper, lower and footer JuliaMono previews compared to native.

Minor subcell ink dropouts are present. Clearly identifiable aligned wire glyphs are retained according to AP policy, without claiming source electrical continuity from a rendered line. No ambiguous full blank cell or uncertain net association was established.
